About Us

Refreshing Lives Through Pure Quality Water.

Sansum Water Limited is committed to providing refreshing, high-quality drinking water for everyday life. We believe that quality, consistency, and customer satisfaction are essential in every bottle we deliver.

Our focus is to make refreshing drinking water accessible to individuals, families, and businesses while building lasting trust through our commitment to quality.

Discover More

Our Process

Inside Our Manufacturing Process

Step inside our facility and see how Sansum Water is produced — from the bottling line to storage, every bottle moves through a modern, well-organised production process.

  • Automated Bottling Line

    Every bottle is filled, capped and packed by modern machinery on our production line.

  • Careful Handling

    Clean, careful handling at every stage of production, from filling to finished packs.

  • Storage & Delivery Ready

    Finished bottles are packed, palletized and stored — ready to move to our customers.

Sansum Water production facility — Dar es Salaam

Quality Commitment

Quality in Every Bottle

Quality is at the heart of everything we do. From purification to bottling, packing and delivery, every stage of our process is handled with care and attention to detail.

We believe that quality, consistency and customer satisfaction are essential in every bottle we deliver — so families and businesses can enjoy Sansum Water with confidence.

  • Purified Drinking Water

    Clean, purified drinking water in every bottle we produce.

  • Consistent Quality

    The same careful process is followed for every bottle — from the first to the last.

  • Securely Sealed & Packed

    Bottles are sealed and packed with care, ready for homes, offices and events.

  • Customer Satisfaction

    Your happiness matters to us — we stand behind every bottle we deliver.
